title: fea.ElectromagneticDomain.atFrequency
description: `domain = fea.ElectromagneticDomain.atFrequency(frequency)` creates an electromagnetic domain at a positive typed frequency.
behaviors: `frequency` must be an `fea.Frequency`; bare numeric values are rejected.
Currents and current densities are authored as signals and excitations.
A model accepts at most one electromagnetic domain.
